node.statement: Node #2 proves the direct-sum-of-matrix-algebras assertion that was previously left implicit, and node #3 shows that noncommutativity forces a block of size at least two and constructs in its 2-by-2 corner contractions u,v with commutator norm exactly 2. These are precisely the assertions of node 1.3.2.
